summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) pricing supplement for $145,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Autocallable Barrier Notes due October 1, 2031, linked to the worst-performing of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, Nasdaq-100 Index and Russell 2000 Index. Notes price at $1,000 each, carry an approximately 11.40% per annum autocallable premium, and are senior unsecured obligations under the Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program. This is a routine structured-note shelf takedown, not a special situation; investors face Jefferies credit risk and principal loss below threshold values.
